result.summary: The intersection features basic sidewalk infrastructure and a curb ramp but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The presence of a stone wall and utility pole at the corner may create sightline issues and minor physical obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing activity.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The stone wall and landscaping on the corner lot may hide pedestrians from drivers.

hazards.name: Utility Pole in Path
hazards.description: A utility pole is positioned at the corner, potentially hindering movement for those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint ladder-style crosswalks to improve visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Tactile Warning Strips
interventions.description: Add truncated domes to the curb ramp for ADA compliance.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Clear vegetation or restrict parking near the corner to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a narrow sidewalk passing under a low railroad bridge, which creates significant sightline obstructions. There is a complete lack of crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or warning signs, making it hazardous for pedestrians to navigate the area.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The bridge abutment and the bridge structure itself severely limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians near the underpass.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road where the sidewalk meets the bridge wall.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs are present in an area where pedestrians may need to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway in the foreground and under the bridge.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to define a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' warning signs with flashing beacons to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians, especially given the poor sightlines.

interventions.title: Improved Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting under the bridge and at the approaches to improve visibility during low-light conditions.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a continuous sidewalk on one side of a two-lane road, but lacks any marked crossings, curb ramps, or traffic calming measures. The straight roadway geometry and lack of pedestrian-oriented infrastructure suggest a design that prioritizes vehicular throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked locations for pedestrians to safely cross the roadway.

hazards.name: Absence of traffic calming
hazards.description: The wide, straight lane configuration may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a pedestrian-adjacent area.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks to provide designated and visible crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: ADA-compliant curb ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps at potential crossing points to ensure accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian warning signage
interventions.description: Add signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians and potential crossing areas.

result.summary: This residential intersection features a marked crosswalk and curb ramps, providing basic pedestrian access. However, safety is limited by faded pavement markings, a lack of visible traffic control signs, and sightline obstructions from corner vegetation and parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Large bushes on the corner block the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the corner

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop sign or yield sign is visible to control traffic flow at this intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the crosswalk and trim corner vegetation to improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and further improve visibility.
